text:
maria: quick sync — if EU is evicted we must ensure tenants flagged 'eu-pii' never execute outside EU. legal insist.
ken: agree. fail-closed for those tenants. return 503 rather than execute on US pool.
devon: simple proxy rule: if tenant.residency == 'eu-pii' && region != 'eu' -> 503. else route.
ashley: cache note: do not hydrate residency-tagged keys into foreign-region caches. default deny unless tenant opts in.
ken: add metrics: residency.exec_blocked and residency.cache_blocked. trace tag residency.enforced=true.
ops-bot: chaos-svc: eu outage drill tomorrow 09:00 UTC. @ken @devon @ashley please validate canary.
maria: action items: devon -> PR for proxy short-circuit; ken -> metrics + canary; ashley -> confirm legal cache-read policy and update runbook. confirm by EOD.
ken: confirmed. :thumbsup:
